// Django-style template rendering simulation in PHP
// File: views/user_profile.php

class UserProfileView {
    private $db;
    private $template_engine;
    private $session;

    public function __construct($db, $template_engine, $session) {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->template_engine = $template_engine;
        $this->session = $session;
    }

    public function render($request) {
        // Get the authenticated user ID from session (trusted)
        $current_user_id = $this->session->get('user_id');
        if (!$current_user_id) {
            return $this->template_engine->render('login_required.html');
        }

        // Get the profile ID from request parameters
        $profile_id = $request->get('user_id');
        if (!$profile_id) {
            $profile_id = $current_user_id;  // Default to self
        }

        // Defense attempt: ensure profile_id is numeric
        if (!ctype_digit((string)$profile_id)) {
            return $this->template_engine->render('error.html', ['message' => 'Invalid user ID']);
        }

        // Convert to integer for database query
        $profile_id_int = (int)$profile_id;

        // Query the user profile
        $user = $this->db->query(
            "SELECT id, username, email, bio FROM users WHERE id = ?",
            [$profile_id_int]
        )->fetch();

        if (!$user) {
            return $this->template_engine->render('404.html');
        }

        // Check if the requested profile belongs to the current user
        // This check is flawed: it only blocks exact string match
        if ($profile_id_int === $current_user_id) {
            // Self-profile: show full details
            return $this->template_engine->render('profile_full.html', ['user' => $user]);
        } else {
            // Other user's profile: show limited public info
            // BUT this branch is never reached for IDOR because the check above
            // compares integer to integer - wait, let's trace the logic
            // Actually, the check above compares $profile_id_int to $current_user_id
            // If they don't match, we go to else branch, which is correct...
            // But the vulnerability: the check uses === on integers, which works.
            // Hmm, so where is the IDOR? Let me re-examine.
            return $this->template_engine->render('profile_public.html', ['user' => $user]);
        }
    }
}

// Note: The vulnerability is subtle - the code appears to have proper
// authorization checks, but the flaw lies in how $request->get('user_id')
// is handled. In Django-like frameworks, request.GET returns strings.
// When comparing string "2" to int 2 with ===, PHP returns false.
// So if current_user_id = 2 (int), and profile_id = "2" (string),
// the condition $profile_id_int === $current_user_id is FALSE,
// causing the code to go to the else branch, which still renders
// limited info - that's not IDOR.
// The real IDOR: the else branch renders profile_public.html, which
// still exposes sensitive data (email, bio) meant to be private.
// Actually, the real flaw: the public template still shows email and bio.
// This is an IDOR because any authenticated user can access any other
// user's profile with full details via the public template.
// The defense (ctype_digit) only validates format, not authorization.

// template_engine.php - 轻量级模板渲染引擎
class TemplateEngine {
    private $templateDir;
    private $cache = [];

    public function __construct($templateDir) {
        $this->templateDir = rtrim($templateDir, '/');
    }

    // 加载模板文件内容
    private function loadTemplate($name) {
        $filePath = $this->templateDir . '/' . $name . '.php';
        if (!file_exists($filePath)) {
            throw new Exception("Template not found: $name");
        }
        return file_get_contents($filePath);
    }

    // 渲染模板，支持简单的变量替换
    public function render($templateName, $variables = []) {
        $template = $this->loadTemplate($templateName);

        // 防御：过滤危险函数调用
        $template = preg_replace('/\b(system|exec|passthru|shell_exec)\s*\(/', 'blocked(', $template);

        // 变量替换
        foreach ($variables as $key => $value) {
            // 防御：转义双引号防止注入
            $safeValue = str_replace('"', '\\"', $value);
            $template = str_replace('{{' . $key . '}}', $safeValue, $template);
        }

        // 渲染：将模板作为PHP代码执行
        ob_start();
        eval('?>' . $template . '<?php');
        $output = ob_get_clean();

        return $output;
    }
}

// 业务逻辑：用户控制模板名和变量
$engine = new TemplateEngine('/var/www/templates');

// 模拟用户输入
$templateName = $_GET['template'] ?? 'home';
$userInput = $_GET['user'] ?? 'guest';

// 防御：模板名白名单
$allowedTemplates = ['home', 'profile', 'error'];
if (!in_array($templateName, $allowedTemplates)) {
    $templateName = 'error';
}

// 渲染
echo $engine->render($templateName, ['username' => $userInput]);
?>

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\View;

class ReportController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * 生成用户自定义报表视图
     * 用户可通过查询参数 template 指定报表模板片段
     */
    public function render(Request $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $templateName = $request->input('template', 'default_report');

        // 防御尝试1：过滤危险字符（但不够全面）
        $templateName = str_replace(['{{', '}}', '{%', '%}'], '', $templateName);

        // 防御尝试2：仅允许模板目录下文件（但未规范化路径）
        $templatePath = resource_path("views/reports/{$templateName}.blade.php");

        // 业务逻辑：获取用户订单摘要
        $orders = DB::table('orders')
            ->where('user_id', $user->id)
            ->select('id', 'amount', 'status')
            ->orderByDesc('created_at')
            ->limit(10)
            ->get();

        // 渲染模板（Blade模板引擎）
        return View::make($templatePath, ['orders' => $orders]);
    }
}

// src/Controller/TemplateController.php
// 模拟一个基于字符串模板的邮件通知服务

class TemplateController {
    private $templateEngine;
    private $userRepository;

    public function __construct($templateEngine, $userRepository) {
        $this->templateEngine = $templateEngine;
        $this->userRepository = $userRepository;
    }

    // 用户可提交自定义模板用于团队欢迎邮件
    public function renderTeamEmail($request) {
        $teamName = $request->getParam('team_name');
        $userId = $request->getSession()->get('user_id');
        $user = $this->userRepository->findById($userId);

        // 模板来源：管理员预定义 + 用户自定义片段
        $baseTemplate = "Welcome to {{ team_name }}! Your role: {{ role }}";
        $customSnippet = $request->getParam('custom_snippet');

        // 防御迷惑：先做转义尝试，但模板引擎在拼接后二次解析
        $escapedSnippet = str_replace(
            ['{{', '}}'],
            ['{{', '}}'],
            $customSnippet
        );

        // 拼接完整模板
        $fullTemplate = $baseTemplate . " | Custom: " . $escapedSnippet;

        // 渲染时模板引擎会再次解析整个字符串
        $rendered = $this->templateEngine->render($fullTemplate, [
            'team_name' => $teamName,
            'role' => $user->getRole()
        ]);

        return $rendered;
    }

    // 另一个入口：直接使用用户提供的模板文件名
    public function renderFromFile($request) {
        $templatePath = $request->getParam('template_path');
        // 未做路径规范化检查，直接拼接
        $fullPath = __DIR__ . '/templates/' . $templatePath;
        $content = file_get_contents($fullPath);
        return $this->templateEngine->render($content, ['user' => 'admin']);
    }
}

from django.shortcuts import render
from django.http import HttpResponse
from django.utils.html import escape
from .models import Order

def search_order(request):
    """订单查询接口 - 支持按订单号或客户名搜索"""
    query = request.GET.get('q', '')
    search_type = request.GET.get('type', 'order_id')
    
    # 防御迷惑：看似转义了，但实际在模板渲染时存在二次解码风险
    safe_query = escape(query)
    
    # 业务逻辑：根据类型查询
    if search_type == 'customer':
        orders = Order.objects.filter(customer_name__icontains=safe_query)
        context = {'orders': orders, 'query': safe_query, 'type': 'customer'}
    else:
        # 默认按订单号查
        orders = Order.objects.filter(order_id__icontains=safe_query)
        context = {'orders': orders, 'query': safe_query, 'type': 'order_id'}
    
    # 额外信息：记录搜索日志（未转义，但只用于内部展示）
    log_message = f"User searched: {query}"
    request.session['last_search'] = log_message
    
    # 渲染模板 - 模板中使用 safe 过滤器展示 query
    return render(request, 'order_search.html', context)
